name: Surat Trade and Mercantile Limited
about: Surat Trade and Mercantile Limited engages in the commodity trading business and other commodity related activities in India. It buys and sells metal, such as gold and silver; and other products. The company was formerly known as Surat Textile Mills Limited and changed its name to Surat Trade and Mercantile Limited in September 2023. Surat Trade and Mercantile Limited was incorporated in 1945 and is based in Surat, India.
